event_tolerance.rationale: The dataset guide reports a maximum 1.4167 s label-start offset for telemetry-based rogue-program attacks; 1.5 s rounds this up. A 0.5 s trailing tolerance is one telemetry tick.

inventory_use_note: Offline-demo inventory only; this status is not human approval for deployment or live scanning.

bias_drift.assessment_reason: Sensor-value attack; use aligned sensor data, not telemetry alone.

clock_skew.assessment_reason: Aggregate stamp-lag/late counters may expose changes at low temporal resolution.

delay.assessment_reason: 2 Hz aggregates expose some lag/gap effects but cannot resolve message-level timing.

drop.assessment_reason: 2 Hz rate/gap aggregates may expose drops but hide individual message loss.

duplicate.assessment_reason: Aggregate rates may change; telemetry cannot establish message identity or duplication.

false_contact.assessment_reason: Contact-value attack; telemetry does not carry contact payload values.

flood.assessment_reason: Per-topic rate and gap telemetry can expose elevated traffic in the simulated runs.

freeze.assessment_reason: Sensor-value attack; use aligned sensor data, not telemetry alone.

jump.assessment_reason: Sensor-value attack; use aligned sensor data, not telemetry alone.

missed_contact.assessment_reason: No real collision occurs in these simulations; guide says it looks like normal.

noise.assessment_reason: Sensor-value attack; telemetry does not carry sensor values.

param_tamper.assessment_reason: The guide describes this as a deliberately added weak target; effects may be indirect.

replay.assessment_reason: Sensor-value attack; use aligned sensor data, not telemetry alone.

service_abuse.assessment_reason: The guide describes this as a deliberately added weak target; service counts are team instrumentation.

spoof.assessment_reason: New-node and publisher-count telemetry provide an observable indicator; identity is not authenticated.

unauthorized_node.assessment_reason: new_nodes and graph-count/hash telemetry identify an unexpected ROS node name.

unauthorized_subscription.assessment_reason: New-node and subscriber-count telemetry provide an observable indicator, not proof of payload access.

small_sample_warning: There are only 3 held-out events for spoof, unauthorized_node, and unauthorized_subscription. Their point estimates and confidence intervals are too imprecise to claim reliability.

rules_false_alert_diagnostics.definition: Matches the evaluation false-alert mask: after 15 seconds of startup and outside event start-1.5 seconds through event stop+0.5 seconds. Episodes are contiguous flagged telemetry ticks; rule-specific episode counts can overlap and therefore do not sum to the combined episode count.

limitations: Seed 3 is a single held-out simulation seed, not external validation.
Metrics for classes not used as supervised training positives are diagnostic only.
Telemetry has no host/IP/MAC/DDS participant identity or topic-payload access evidence.
There is no movement-command topic or live bridge/domain change stream in the recordings.
No real-time, real-vehicle, or safety-critical performance is established.
